err.ac_power_required: macOS benchmarks require AC power. Connect the power adapter and retry.
err.auth_required: Remote server rejected access (HTTP 401/403). Check credentials and permissions, then retry.
err.batch_plan_not_finished: Batch plan still has unfinished cases. Continue running under the locked plan.
err.binding_progress_changed: Workspace or configuration binding stage changed. Binding stopped.
err.blocked: Device check has not passed yet. Review prerequisites and retry.
err.cancelled: Operation cancelled. Check progress and retry if needed.
err.candidate_binding_invalid: Binding artifacts do not match the current bundle or results directory. Run stopped.
err.candidate_description_invalid: CLI configuration descriptor does not match the current interface. Please upgrade the CLI.
err.candidate_endpoint_mismatch: Service endpoint does not match the locked configuration. Enter the local endpoint used when creating the configuration.
err.candidate_mismatch: Benchmark configuration does not match the selected combination. Please retry.
err.chat_template_unavailable: Model is missing a chat template and cannot be used for this chat benchmark.
err.cli_blocked: CLI refused to execute. Check the reported limitations.
err.cli_error: CLI execution failed. Check the error details and run status below, then retry.
err.cli_outdated: CLI version is outdated or missing required commands. Upgrade the CLI and retry.
err.cli_unavailable: CLI is not ready. Configure its path in the main window.
err.cmake_missing: CMake (3.24 or later) is missing. Please install it first.
err.conflict: Operation conflicts with the current state. Refresh progress and retry.
err.connection_error: Network connection failed or was interrupted. Check network and proxy settings, then retry.
err.device_preflight_blocked: Device check produced no runnable recommendation. Review the device report and retry.
err.disk_full: Insufficient disk space to write files. Free up disk space and retry.
err.download_failed: Download failed. Check your network connection and retry.
err.duration_resume_requires_new_window: Duration-based runs cannot be resumed. Start a new run window under the locked plan.
err.error: CLI execution error. Check the error details below and retry.
err.health_timeout: Model list is reachable, but health check timed out.
err.health_unreachable: Model list is reachable, but health check connection, transport, or protocol failed.
err.incomplete: Run is incomplete. Check the stop reason before continuing.
err.install_checksum_failed: The downloaded file failed checksum verification. Installation aborted. Please retry.
err.install_failed: Automatic CLI installation failed. Retry or use "Specify Path Manually".
err.install_unpack_failed: Failed to unpack installer archive. Retry or follow the manual installation guide.
err.install_unsupported: No automatic installer is available for this platform. Follow the manual installation guide.
err.install_version_unknown: Unable to determine which CLI version to install. Follow the manual installation guide.
err.internal_error: Internal Studio error. Check the error details below and retry.
err.invalid_input: Invalid input. Check the parameters and retry.
err.invalid_library_manifest: Engine runtime libraries are incomplete or have invalid links.
err.invalid_request: Input does not meet requirements. Check paths, URLs, and environment variable names.
err.io_error: File read/write failed. Check directory permissions and retry.
err.listener_enumeration_failed: Unable to read connection table or enumerate processes. Discovery failed.
err.listener_ownership_incomplete: Some listening processes were unreadable, exited, or indeterminate. Scan incomplete.
err.listener_table_incomplete: Part of the connection table was unreadable or contained invalid entries. Scan incomplete.
err.model_acquire_incomplete: Model download did not complete. Check the details, network, or directory status below and retry.
err.model_discovery_limit: The models directory exceeds the scan depth limit. Place models in a shallower dedicated directory.
err.model_discovery_unreadable: Unable to read the models directory. Check the path and permissions.
err.models_http_3xx: Model list returned HTTP 3xx without following redirects.
err.models_http_4xx: Model list returned HTTP 4xx. Authentication may be required.
err.models_unreachable: Model list connection, transport, or HTTP protocol failed.
err.network_timeout: Network request or read timed out. Check your connection and retry.
err.no_local_model: No local models available yet. Download a model on the Downloads page or configure a models directory in Settings.
err.not_found: Required file, record, or remote resource was not found. Check paths, workspace status, or download URL and retry.
err.not_resumable: This run cannot be resumed. Start a new benchmark using New Task.
err.output_exists: Output directory already exists. Choose a new directory.
err.output_name_exhausted: The first 1,000 directory names are already taken. Choose a different name or workspace.
err.package_resource_invalid: Built-in CLI resources are invalid. Reinstall or upgrade the CLI.
err.permission_denied: Insufficient file or directory write permissions. Check target directory permissions and retry.
err.previous_scope_incomplete: The previous bundle did not finish completely, so subsequent bundles have not run. Resolve the stop reason first.
err.process_identity_unavailable: Some listening process names were unreadable or their startup identity changed. Scan incomplete.
err.rate_limited: Remote download request was rate-limited (HTTP 429). Retry later.
err.report_unreadable: Report file is unreadable or invalid. Please regenerate it.
err.run_active: A benchmark is currently running. Cancel it and wait for cleanup before stopping the engine.
err.runtime_asset_mismatch: Runtime files do not match the manifest.
err.runtime_profile_mismatch: Runtime receipt does not match the profile.
err.runtime_receipt_missing: Engine directory is missing a runtime receipt and cannot be verified.
err.service_closing: Studio is shutting down and cannot accept new tasks.
err.service_discovery_error: Local service discovery failed. Check permissions and refresh manually.
err.service_discovery_invalid_response: Invalid CLI service discovery response format. Upgrade the CLI and retry.
err.service_discovery_unsupported_platfo: Local service discovery is not supported on this platform.
err.service_identity_unavailable: Unable to verify startup identity of the background process. Check PID and process permissions.
err.service_identity_unreadable: Unable to read bound process identity. Check process permissions and refresh.
err.service_process_unavailable: Connected service process is unavailable. Refresh the service list and re-select.
err.settings_incomplete: Directory configuration is incomplete. Configure required directories first.
err.single_run_resume_not_supported: Single runs do not support resuming. Re-run this configuration instead.
err.startup_arguments_mismatch: Startup arguments do not match the benchmark configuration. Binding stopped. Check the benchmark configuration and engine settings.
err.token_env_missing: Specified access token environment variable is unset or invalid. Configure it in your system environment and retry.
err.transfer_error: A network protocol or transfer error occurred during download. Please retry.
err.unexpected_content_encoding: Remote response uses an unsupported content encoding. Download aborted.
err.unknown: CLI exited unexpectedly. Check the error details and run status below, then retry.
err.unknown_code: Operation failed ({code}). Check the error details below and retry.
err.unsupported_engine_build: Engine version does not meet benchmark requirements.
err.unsupported_platform: This benchmark configuration workflow is not supported on the current platform.
err.unsupported_report_format: Legacy report format is not supported. Regenerate the report with the current CLI.
err.unsupported_runtime_profile: Engine runtime profile is not supported.
err.upstream_http_error: Remote server returned an unexpected HTTP status. Retry later or verify the download URL.
err.workspace_busy: The workspace still has an active run or managed engine. Finish the task and stop the engine first.
